name_as_stated: the South African Bank Note Company (RF) Proprietary Limited (SABN)
detail: The South African Reserve Bank says the South African Bank Note Company (RF) Proprietary Limited prints South Africa's banknotes and that it is a subsidiary of the SARB.
source_title: Banknotes and coins production (South African Reserve Bank)

detail: The Swiss National Bank states that Orell Füssli Security Printing Ltd prints the ninth series of Swiss franc banknotes.
The Swiss National Bank states that Landqart supplies the three-layer banknote substrate Durasafe used for Swiss franc notes.

entity: Banknote Printing and Minting Works of the National Bank of Ukraine
name_as_stated: Banknote Printing and Minting Works of the National Bank of Ukraine
detail: A National Bank of Ukraine interview states that hryvnia banknotes are printed at the Banknote Printing and Minting Works of the National Bank of Ukraine, which is part of the NBU.
source_title: Vasyl Ishchenko: Ukrainian money has sophisticated security features and enjoys high durability (National Bank of Ukraine)

detail: The same National Bank of Ukraine item states that the paper for hryvnia banknotes is made at the Banknote Paper Mill in Malyn; the source does not state its ownership.
source_title: Vasyl Ishchenko: Ukrainian money has sophisticated security features and enjoys high durability (National Bank of Ukraine)

detail: The Business Standard reports that Bangladesh's taka notes are printed by The Security Printing Corporation Limited, known locally as Takshal, at a site in Gazipur covering about 66 acres, in operation since 1989.
source_title: Where and how is our taka printed? (The Business Standard)

detail: The Banco de España states that IMBISA (Imprenta de Billetes S.A.), 80% owned by the Banco de España, prints the euro banknotes allocated to Spain, roughly 12% of total euro banknote production.
source_title: IMBISA: The banknotes factory that guarantees cash in Spain and the Eurosystem (Banco de España, Portal del Cliente Bancario)

detail: A joint Banque de France press release names OeBS as the banknote printer owned by the Oesterreichische Nationalbank, one of three central-bank-owned printers strengthening cooperation on banknote production.
source_title: Banque de France, OeNB and Banco de Portugal strengthen cooperation on banknote production (Banque de France)

detail: The same Banque de France press release names Valora as the banknote printer owned by the Banco de Portugal.
source_title: Banque de France, OeNB and Banco de Portugal strengthen cooperation on banknote production (Banque de France)

detail: Wikipedia states that the Security Printing and Minting Organization, a subsidiary of the Central Bank of Iran since 1962, is responsible for the design, production and elimination of banknotes and coinage in Iran, and that banknotes were printed abroad until 1982.
as_of: subsidiary since 23 September 1962; printing in Iran since 1982

detail: The Jakarta Post reports that Bank Indonesia assigned Peruri, described as the state banknote printing firm, to print the new banknotes, which were printed at Peruri's facility in Karawang, West Java.
source_title: Peruri denies private firm in Central Java printed banknotes (The Jakarta Post)

entity: De La Rue Lanka Currency and Security Print (Pvt) Ltd
name_as_stated: De La Rue Lanka Currency & Security Print (Pvt) Ltd
detail: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka states in its currency FAQ that its currency notes are printed by De La Rue Lanka Currency & Security Print (Pvt) Ltd at Biyagama, Sri Lanka.
source_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Currency (Central Bank of Sri Lanka)

detail: The Bank of Papua New Guinea states in its FAQ that its banknotes are printed in Australia by a company called Note Printing Australia.
source_title: Does the Bank also print these currencies in the country? (Bank of Papua New Guinea FAQ)

detail: The Magyar Nemzeti Bank states that forint banknotes are printed by the Hungarian Banknote Printing Company, an enterprise wholly owned by the MNB.
source_title: Production of banknotes and coins (Magyar Nemzeti Bank)

detail: The Magyar Nemzeti Bank states that the special paper for forint banknotes is made by the Diósgyőr Papermill, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Hungarian Banknote Printing Company.
source_title: Production of banknotes and coins (Magyar Nemzeti Bank)

detail: Addis Fortune reports that the National Bank of Ethiopia awarded Francois-Charles Oberthur Fiduciaire of France a 19.6 million Br share of a 206 million Br banknote printing deal, covering the 50 Br note.
source_title: Two Overseas Firms Seal Deal to Print Banknotes (Addis Fortune)

detail: Addis Fortune reports that the National Bank of Ethiopia awarded De La Rue of the United Kingdom a 187 million Br share of a 206 million Br banknote printing deal, covering the 100 Br note.
source_title: Two Overseas Firms Seal Deal to Print Banknotes (Addis Fortune)

detail: PWPW states that a collector's banknote issued by the National Bank of Poland was manufactured by Polska Wytwornia Papierow Wartosciowych S.A.; the source covers that banknote only, not the general circulation series.
source_title: New collector's banknote (Polska Wytwórnia Papierów Wartościowych)
